name: groups
description: Groups in a body, which add no depth to the DOM (engine §9).

name: groups-syntax-later
description: Groups, and a syntax error after them.

name: optionals
description: Optionals, an expression nested too deep.

name: optionals-error-later
description: Optionals, and an error of reading after them.

name: term-parens
description: Parentheses around a tag in a tag term.

name: implications
description: Conditions joined by ⟹, which group to the right.

name: guards
description: Guards in a row before a tag term.

name: unions
description: Unions, each in parentheses inside the one before.

name: any-groups
description: Conditions joined by ∨, each group in parentheses inside the one before, which the reader folds into one.

name: long-name
description: A rule name of many characters, which the lexical stage reads as one token.

name: long-capture
description: A capture name of many characters.

name: long-guard
description: A guard name of many characters.

name: long-tag
description: A tag literal of many characters in a tag term.

name: comment-of-openers
description: A comment that holds many quotes, comment openers and prefixes, each of which could begin a token.

name: long-string
description: A string of many characters in a test.

name: string-of-escapes
description: A string of many escaped quotes and backslashes in a test.
